notes.title: Happy 9 years of Super Time Force Ultra 🔫⏱️✨
notes.content:
[b]Happy 9 years of Super Time Force Ultra[/b] 🔫⏱️✨ 

We’re celebrating its release on PC today, which is why it’s an [b]ULTRA[/b] anniversary! Time sure flies by… both for the company and in-game! 

Thank you to everyone who has supported this action-packed game; it’s very beloved within the team so we hope the love for it stays and grows amongst you all! 💙✨

Interested in some fun facts and cool insight about the game and its development? Catch our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/capygames]stream on Twitch[/url] [strike]next Monday on August 28th![/strike] on Friday, September 1st!

[i]KOOKABUNGA![/i]

notes.title: PYRO, SAXTON HALE & ZOEY JOIN SUPER TIME FORCE ULTRA
notes.content:
[b]Super Time Force Ultra is coming to Steam on August 25th[/b] for $14.99, and it’s bringing along three new friends that should be a little familiar…

We’re ULTRA excited to give Steam players a chance to travel through time with some of their favorite Team Fortress 2 and Left 4 Dead characters: [b]PYRO, SAXTON HALE & ZOEY![/b]

Hop over to the [url=http://supertimeforce.com/stfu-on-steam-adds-tf2-l4d-characters/]Super Time Force website[/url] to learn more (and check out some cool gifs)!
